steps.en: Render your tool's name into a banner string, in-process
steps.zh: 在进程内把工具名渲染成横幅字符串

steps.en: Maps each letter through one of 677 fonts bundled in the package — no system figlet
steps.zh: 用随包发布的 677 种字体逐字拼出大图，不调系统 figlet

steps.en: Wrap the banner with a decorative border
Hands back one plain str — print it, log it, or paste it into your README
steps.zh: 交回一个普通字符串：打印、记日志、贴进 README 都行

value.en: A figlet-style ASCII banner from a pip install — no C binary, no subprocess, identical on Windows, macOS and Linux
value.zh: 一次 pip install 即得 figlet 风格横幅：无 C 二进制、无子进程，跨平台表现一致
